name: Shandong Weigao Orthopaedic Device Co., Ltd
summary: Shandong Weigao Orthopaedic Device Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and sales of orthopedic medical devices. The company offers orthopedic implantable medical devices and orthopedic surgical instruments. It also provides spinal products, such as internal fixation systems for the cervical and thoracic/lumbar spine, and interbody fusion devices; trauma-related products include locking plate systems, intramedullary nail systems, hollow screw systems, and external fixation systems; and joint products, including hip joint prosthesis systems, knee joint prosthesis systems, and shoulder joint prosthesis systems.
